parsed.name: Timepix/Medipix 像素探测器
parsed.description: 用于控制 Timepix/Medipix 像素探测器的高层接口，可配置像素阈值、掩膜、测试脉冲和多项 DAC 偏置参数，并执行设备设置、采集启动/停止、数据记录及以太网通信配置，适用于辐射探测、粒子成像和时间相关测量实验。
parsed.description_en: A high-level control interface for a Timepix/Medipix pixel detector. It supports configuring pixel thresholds, masks, test pulses, and multiple DAC bias parameters, as well as device setup, acquisition start/stop, data recording, and Ethernet communication settings for radiation detection, particle imaging, and time-related measurements.
